name: miniconda-python-env
description: Reuse or create safe Windows Python environments with explicit lifecycle, ownership, cleanup, and dependency rules.

interface.shortDescription: Reuse or create isolated Python environments safely on Windows.
interface.longDescription: Chooses an existing project environment before creating one, keeps trigger origin separate from retention lifecycle, preserves reused environment channel policy, cleans up only newly-created temporary envs, and safely exports dependency manifests for kept conda environments.
